integrity: The global threshold proof uses an exact Lyapunov identity and invariant-set argument. The sharp rate is derived from the simple critical eigenvalue and an explicitly controlled stable-subspace decomposition. The packaged checker verifies the displayed algebra on exact rational data but is not substituted for the generic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the deterministic uncontrolled four-stage model at the exact threshold and does not prove robustness under perturbations, stochasticity, or controls. The literature search cannot exclude obscure or unindexed prior work.
title: Critical date-palm-mite extinction is globally stable with a universal \(t^{-1}\) stage profile
